fonts.display: 'sans-serif', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Satoshi', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Page White
palette.role: Page background, card surfaces, button text on blue

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Primary heading text, heavy borders, icon fills, image framing

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Body text, nav text, secondary borders — slightly softer than pure black for long-form readability

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Tertiary text, disabled states, fine metadata

palette.name: Mist
palette.role: Hairline dividers, nav accents, light surface variation

palette.name: Wash Blue
palette.role: Soft blue surface wash for highlighted sections and subtle backgrounds

palette.name: Signal Blue
palette.role: Primary CTA fills, active link borders, key accent — the only chromatic color allowed to draw the eye

palette.name: Link Blue
palette.role: Lighter blue for link text and secondary outlined actions
